people.name: Eunice
people.line: Mother of Timothy; a Jewish believer.

people.name: Lois
people.line: Grandmother of Timothy; commended for her faith

people.name: father_of_Eunice
people.line: Father of Eunice - Grandfather of Timothy

translations.web: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice, and, I am persuaded, in you also.
translations.bsb: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
translations.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
translations.asv: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.
